title: AI Performance Video Editor
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
Remote Full-time $1.5K-$2.5K/month + uncapped performance bonuses

Hi, I'm Yente, co-founder of Primal Storm.

In nine months, we grew from having no customers and a $1,000 CPA to generating more than $1 million in monthly revenue. Our next goal is to reach $5 million in monthly revenue by December.

We are looking for an AI Performance Video Editor to help us achieve it.

We're hiring AI video editor to help us get there.

About Primal Storm

Our mission is to help people improve their health and well-being through natural products and a supportive community.

We are a fully remote, performance-driven DTC company with:
- A team of 39 talented professionals.
- Two hands-on founders who work closely with the team.
- A fast-paced and collaborative working environment.
- Internal merchandise, design competitions and performance-based prizes.
- Leaders who are accessible and committed to supporting professional growth.
key_responsibilities:
What you'll actually do:
- Edit 6-20 performance ads per week for campaigns with active advertising spend.
- Create hyperrealistic AI UGC, animated ads and high-quality voiceovers.
- Produce AI song ads and animations in styles such as 3D and claymation.
- Develop new hooks, concepts and variations based on performance data.
- Analyse results and improve creatives through continuous testing and iteration.
- Deliver high-quality work quickly and consistently.
- Communicate progress clearly and identify potential blockers early.
- Take ownership of deadlines and maintain a high level of responsiveness.

Performance Bonus System

Every ad earns XP based on the advertising spend it generates. As your XP level increases, so does your bonus multiplier.

When your ads scale, your earning potential grows with them.

This role may Not be the right fit If you:
- Focus primarily on visual quality without considering advertising performance.
- Require frequent follow-ups or regularly miss deadlines.
- Are only available for part-time or short-term work.
qualifications:
Who we're looking for:
- At least one year of experience creating performance ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.
- A strong portfolio demonstrating direct-response and performance-focused work.
- Experience producing realistic AI UGC that feels natural and authentic.
- Experience creating AI-generated song ads, animations and voiceovers.
- A clear understanding of how creative decisions affect advertising performance.
- The ability to manage a fast-paced, high-volume production schedule.
- Strong communication, accountability and attention to detail.
- Full-time availability and interest in a long-term collaboration.

If you are a performance-focused editor who combines creative judgment, AI production skills and a strong sense of ownership, we would be happy to review your application.

$1.5K-2.5K/mo base + uncapped bonuses on every winning ad you ship, scaling automatically with your XP level. Top performers compound fast.

Ready to join Primal Storm? Complete the application form to be considered for the role.

Thank you for your interest in joining the Primal Storm team and helping us dominate the eCommerce space together.
